ui.title: Minecraft servers
ui.no-servers: No server folders found (a folder in the home directory with server.properties and run.sh).
ui.copy-address: Copy the address players join with: {address}
ui.notices-on: Join/leave notifications on (click to turn off)
ui.notices-off: Join/leave notifications off (click to turn on)
ui.lag-line: Lagging {ago}: up to {behind} s behind ({count} warnings in the last 5 min)
ui.restore-tip: Put this backup back. The current world is kept next to it as world.before-restore-<date>.
ui.autorestart-on: Auto-restart after a crash is on (click to turn off)
ui.autorestart-off: Auto-restart after a crash is off (click to turn on)
ui.auto-last: Restarted itself {ago} ({count} in the last 30 min)
ui.auto-gave-up: Auto-restart gave up {ago}: it crashed 3 times in 30 min
ui.ram-pending: Restart to use the new RAM
ui.ram-hint: Saved in {file}; used from the next start
ui.ram-invalid: Min must be at least 0.5 GB and not above max; max at most {top} GB
ui.add-server: Add a server from a server pack zip
ui.add-hint: Upload a server pack zip. It is unpacked into a new folder in the server's home directory; nothing is overwritten.
ui.add-none: No zips with "server" in the name in Downloads.
ui.add-link: Or a direct download link to the server zip
ui.add-busy: An upload or download is running.
ui.install-picking: Choose the zip in the file picker…
ui.install-done: {name} is unpacked into ~/{folder}. Finish its setup below.
ui.setup-script-missing: No run.sh yet. Pick how to make one:
ui.setup-installer-tip: Runs java -jar <installer> --installServer in the server's tmux console. It usually makes run.sh.
ui.setup-use-script-tip: Start runs this script instead of run.sh.
ui.setup-port-used: Also used by {servers}: they can't run at the same time
ui.setup-finish-tip: Needs a start script, a port and the EULA. Then it gets a normal card with Start.
ui.convert-flagged: Lines marked CHECK couldn't be translated. Look at them before saving.
ui.convert-nojava: No java line was found, so this run.sh won't start the server.
ui.no-host: No ssh host set. Open this plugin's settings and enter the ssh host of your server box.
ui.deploy-tip: Copies server/agent.py to the box's agent folder over ssh.
ui.add-unpack-tip: Unpacks it into a new folder next to it. The zip stays.
ui.rename-session: tmux session becomes "{session}" on the next restart

host.label: SSH host
host.description: The box your servers run on: an alias from ~/.ssh/config or user@host. It needs key login without a password prompt.

folder.label: Agent folder
folder.description: Folder in the box's home directory for the agent and its state. Also names this PC's cache and config folders.

ports.label: Open ports
ports.description: Port range new servers can pick from, like 25565-25575. Use the ports your box's firewall lets in.

title.label: Panel title
title.description: Shown at the top of the panel and on notifications.
